answer: Physical attestation makes the requirement indivisible: lantern verifies the RAM and physical sale of each jade unit, while saffron permanently groups units by beneficial purchaser. Running \(k\) identities requires one jade unit with \(k^4\) TB of attested RAM; rented or distributed memory does not count. One identity needs 1 TB. Ten clones need one 10,000-TB unit, and head ten adds 3,439 TB. Fresh keys cannot reset the tally; an unrelated purchaser’s debut still needs 1 TB.
